animations.name: Strong Punch Low
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied low kneeling crouch guard pose. Perform ONE SINGLE heavy Guile-style slanted crouching uppercut across the clip (strictly one uppercut only, never twice), pure body motion only in empty air: staying low on the baseline without standing tall, he leans his heavy torso slightly back and drops his right fist low to wind up, then rips ONE massive, wide-arcing heavy right uppercut angled forward-upward (~60 degrees) while his left arm braces tightly across his waist; brief heavy apex, then smooth return to the starting crouch guard pose. Preserve exact face, beard, plaid shirt, cargo pants, sneakers, scale and pixel art. Keep the entire body and raised fist cleanly inside the 512x512 frame with margin on all edges. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
